Maya: Nightly eval alert :rotating_light: model=rwdx-1.2.0-quant4 (candidate) vs rwdx-1.2.0 (float)
Maya: Failed suites: commonsenseQA, news-summarization, ct-coverage-qa. EM drop ~12%, ROUGE-L -8% on news-summ.
Maya: Log + diffs: https://ci.redwood.ai/12345
Maya: cc @Tony @Olga @Joan

CI-Bot: nightly-eval job #12345 completed — 3 failing suites. Results: https://ci.redwood.ai/12345/results

Tony: reading the ci logs now. any minimal failing prompts?

Maya: paste of one failing example:

```text
prompt_id: csq_4821
prompt: "Why did the mouse run?"
expected: "Because the cat was chasing it."
candidate (float): "It ran to hide from the cat."
candidate (quant4): "Because it likes cheese."
``` 

Olga: that looks like semantic collapse on short commonsense cues. suspect quantization of softmax or kv-cache noise.

Olga: can someone re-run quant4 with `--disable-softmax-quant` and `--no-kv-caching` for commonsenseQA quickcheck?

Tony: will run a local reproducer on my 3090 now. I'll post exact seed + prompt batch.

Samir: initial severity? customer-facing? we should classify.

Maya: tentatively P2 — affects accuracy but not latency/availability. owners: Tony (commonsense), Olga (quant research), Joan (infra).

Joan: checking infra logs for the eval cluster — saw one GPU host with intermittent 70% mem pressure, possible transient OOMs around 00:04 UTC. I'll correlate with job id.

Tony: I reproduced the csq_4821 failure locally with seed=42 on quant4-ptx build. Running float baseline first then variant with `--disable-softmax-quant`.

Tony: if disabling softmax quant fixes >90% of the small-set failures, we should roll a canary change to quant pipeline.

Olga: agree. also will try `quant4+gptq-tuning` on a subset to see if calibration helps.

Maya: I'll open a ticket and attach failing prompts + diff artifacts: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/ML-987

Samir: please add remediation plan to ticket (rollout gate, metrics to watch: EM_delta, rouge, hallucination_count)

Maya: will do. next steps: Tony runs reproducer (ETA 45m), Olga runs quant ablations (ETA 2h), Joan correlates infra (ETA 30m). we'll reconvene here after results.

Tony: ack :thumbsup:

Olga: ack :+1:

Joan: ack, ping me if you need logs or host restarts.
